name: Fancy Components
summary: Free open-source fun/weird React microinteractions (Tailwind + Motion) via @fancy shadcn registry.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free registry components of ~40 listed in llms.txt; not a full inventory.
No paid/Pro tier found on fancycomponents.dev or danielpetho/fancy — pricing=free; nothing gated/unlocked.
Finder gaps glass / liquid-glass / dither: Fancy has no glassmorphism or ordered-dither components in this inventory — not tagged. text-scramble filled via scramble-hover + scramble-in.
Pixel Trail / Pixelate SVG Filter are pixelation effects, not dither — pixelate-svg-filter omitted this batch; pixel-trail tagged particles only.
animated-gradient-with-svg: registry/CLI slug differs from docs path `animated-gradient-svg` — iframeSrc uses docs path; install uses registry slug.
ARCHITECTURE §5 prefers iframe for unusual/tactile motion; all demos are docs iframes (no dynamic-import smoke mounts).
Docs CLI often `npx shadcn add @fancy/...` without @latest; catalog uses portable `npx shadcn@latest`. Additional deps may need a separate package-manager install after CLI.

components.name: Scramble Hover
components.summary: Scrambles characters on hover; original or custom character sets.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add @fancy/scramble-hover

import ScrambleHover from "@/components/fancy/text/scramble-hover"

<ScrambleHover text="original characters" scrambleSpeed={50} maxIterations={8} useOriginalCharsOnly={true} className="cursor-pointer" />

copyPrompt.text: Use Fancy Components free component `Scramble Hover` (slug `scramble-hover`) from https://fancycomponents.dev/docs/components/text/scramble-hover. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @fancy/scramble-hover` after `npx shadcn@latest init` and adding the `@fancy` registry (`"@fancy": "https://fancycomponents.dev/r/{name}.json"`) to `components.json` registries (see https://fancycomponents.dev/docs/installation). Registry item: https://fancycomponents.dev/r/scramble-hover.json. Import from `@/components/fancy/text/scramble-hover` after CLI add (path may follow project aliases). Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS; registry/docs also need `motion`. All Fancy Components are free & open source (MIT — https://github.com/danielpetho/fancy/blob/main/LICENSE); prefer free-tier only. Official docs CLI examples often omit `@latest` (`npx shadcn add @fancy/scramble-hover`); catalog uses portable `npx shadcn@latest`.
